name: Union Bancaire Privée
notes: Real, public Oracle Cloud HCM (Candidate Experience) site — verified 2026-08-05, 43 live requisitions. Worked example of the oracle ats type: ats_id is "<host>|<siteNumber>", because the API host is tenant-specific and cannot be derived from the company name. Without this adapter such sites fall to ats=generic and return nothing, since the portal renders its listings client-side.
